description: Wondering about accommodations? Know how to implement accommodations? Just want to visit with friends over coffee and donuts? Please register in advance.   Questions or accommodation requests specific to this event? Please email dsoffice@echo.rutgers.edu, call 848-202-3111, or visit ODS in Lucy Stone Hall, Suite A145, Livingston Campus.
location: Lucy Stone Hall, 1st Floor Lobby, Suite A145, Livingston Campus

description: Let’s Talk With Art Take a break, get creative, and connect.   Let’s Talk With Art is a relaxed, welcoming space for students to explore thoughts, feelings, and experiences through creativity. No artistic experience is needed. Come as you are and use whatever form of expression feels right for you, including drawing, painting, writing, collage, or simply experimenting with something new.   CAPS counselors will be creating alongside you, painting, drawing, and participating in the space with students. They are also available if you want to check in, talk something through, ask a question, or have a more personal conversation during the event.   Each session includes optional creative prompts, space for reflection, and opportunities for conversation and connection. You are also welcome to create independently and participate at your own comfort level.   Art can give us another way to express what may be hard to put into words, slow down, and check in with ourselves.   Fall 2026 Dates:October 1October 15November 5November 19December 3 Join us for one session or come back throughout the semester.
name: Let’s Talk With Art
organizationName: Counseling, Alcohol and Other Drug Assistance Program & Psychiatric Services (University Department)
organizationNames: Counseling, Alcohol and Other Drug Assistance Program & Psychiatric Services (University Department)
